Preconditions: Local Supabase seeded from supabase/seed.sql; pnpm dev:local; a complete request submitted by organiser@test.com and assigned by lead@test.com to Test Coordinator (Under Review); a second request Under Review or Returned
TestSteps: 1. Record withdrawal, then Cancel. 2. Record withdrawal with an empty Note, Confirm withdrawal.
ExpectedResult: Cancel leaves the request Under Review; a blank note withdraws it with decision_record null
